data.narrative:
Bellatrix Aerospace is a pre-Series B space and aerospace company that has raised $31M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, spanning the broader Space & Aerospace sector.

Standard triangulation methods are constrained by data limitations. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while 14 same-sector peers exist, zero meeting same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters were identified—the threshold for a reliable median requires three or more datapoints. Public-comp anchoring using the sector P/S median of 24.4x across the five public tickers cannot be executed without the target's revenue, which private companies rarely disclose.

The absence of sufficient narrow-universe comparables and missing revenue data prevents a defensible quantitative valuation range at this time. A credible analysis would require either: disclosed revenue enabling P/S application, or identification of pre-Series B private transactions at comparable scale and vertical position within the aerospace supply chain. The high multiples observed in public comps (24.4x median P/S) suggest significant valuation heterogeneity in the sector; applying this directly to an undisclosed private company would be misleading without more granular matching criteria.
